LESSON: TIME

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.4: Time
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Time, part of Measurement in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why are days of the week important in our day to day lives?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Sing songs/ rhymes related to days of the week. Learners with speech difficulties could use body percussion such as hum or mime the tune and tap or clap or nod or stamp or flip the fingers or click the tongue rhythmically while singing days of the week.

2. Tell and write/mount/stamp/trace days of the week the way they follow each other. Learners with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication (AAC) to tell. Those with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or appropriate assistive technology to carry 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Sing songs/ rhymes related to days of the week. Learners with speech difficulties could use body percussion such as hum or mime the tune and tap or clap or nod or stamp or flip the fingers or click the tongue rhythmically while singing days of the week.
2. Tell and write/mount/stamp/trace days of the week the way they follow each other. Learners with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication (AAC) to tell. Those with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or appropriate assistive technology to carry 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Time together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: learner confidently sings songs/ rhymes related to days of the week.

● Communication and collaboration: learner discusses and tells hi/her birth month to peers.
